title: The New Boy
text:
There was a new boy in class on Monday. His name was Danish, and he had moved here all the way from Johor.
At recess, Danish sat alone at the end of the bench. He did not open his lunch box. He just looked at his shoes.
Mei Ling noticed him from across the canteen. She thought about how strange it must feel to know nobody at all. So she picked up her tray, walked over, and sat down beside him.
"Do you like football?" she asked.
Danish looked up. For the first time that morning, he smiled.
